full_page.content:
1935, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 287 Jan. Page 288
Mrs. O'Connor ... wants girl .... see .....
Jan. 8 Mrs. Eliz. Klein - 64 - of Rochester, N. Y. - strept-tic-throat in coma ....
Mrs. Mary Moore - 47 - stomach cancer ....
9 Henry Kollhaas - 38 - in Rec. Hospital - flu & spinal maningitis - unconscious at 9:30 a.m.
E. Doolittle - 19 - "spoiled" non C. by Mother- +father - won't help mother.
Virg. Mills - 19 - fainting spells. Mary Asaro - 27 - Sciatica pains ...
Frances Billordello - 17 - Eye trouble Jos. Messina - 7 - extremely delicate
10 Mrs. A. Van Houte - 50 - of Omaha, Neb. broken arm & leg - May 1933 - limbs saved but refuse to heal - Enrolled To-day perpetually.
Art Van Houtte - 51 - Eloise, cancer of stomach - given up as hope- less by Dr's
Page 289 Page 290 Jan. 10 Baby Cal. E. Kennelly - 10 mo. - 10 lbs. - asthma - parents anxious - have one little boy 4 yrs. old.
Jos. Badalamenti - 19 - accidently lost sight in left eye. Dr. says it must come out .... Enrolled To-day for year.
Anna Moiles - 80 - Tebbi ..... asks prayers for herself Grace of happy d ....
Cath. Saunders - 20 - in training for nurse - Mother anxious lest she give up instead of being sister.
13 John Furchak - 59 - very weak ... ? kidney ....
Augusta Sagaert - 40 - cancer of breast coming again. .. anxious. For a time seemed quite promising.
